description: Experimental Flash-Next HC read at M=3/4. Original down/inject kernel and existing E4M3/F32 weight layout. Up projection converts unscaled E4M3 codes exactly to BF16, reorders each 80-column dot with FP32 WMMA, and retains FP32 group scales and the original four-group sum tree. Sigmoid BF16, normalized-stream BF16, mixed-output BF16 and INT8/FP8 quantization boundaries remain unchanged. Stateless quantization uses a third launch; no arrival counters or persistent scratch state. Not a gate PASS or an engine speed claim.
